name: Helve Web Search
description: Web search provider for OpenClaw backed by Helve: one HELVE_API_KEY with ordered fallback across Brave, Tavily, Exa, and Serper plus deterministic spend_limit_usd caps at 0% markup.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Helve API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Helve API key (fallback: HELVE_API_KEY env var). $1 free credit ≈ 1,000 Serper searches at 0% markup. Configure per-key spend_limit_usd at https://helve.dev/dashboard.

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Helve Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Override Helve API base URL (default: https://helve.dev).

webSearch.fallbackOrder.label: Provider Fallback Order
webSearch.fallbackOrder.help: Ordered list of search engines tried on 429, quota, or upstream auth errors (default: brave, tavily, exa, serper).

webSearch.spendLimitUsd.label: Session Spend Limit (USD)
webSearch.spendLimitUsd.help: Optional client-side USD cap for this session in addition to server-side per-key spend_limit_usd.

recommendedPrompts: Search the web with Helve for the latest OpenClaw plugin SDK changes.
Run a Helve web search restricted to docs.openclaw.ai from the past week.
